proposed_boundary.future_delta: Any native amendment must split PA2 from the present common node, preserve C36 on source side, declare exact new pins/nets and recapture native checks; not applied here.

states.name: HOLD
states.rule: Default and missing qualification: request isolation, invalidate samples; verify physical parking separately.

states.name: QUALIFY
states.rule: Require every source/reference/power-state/interface qualification, stable reference and a fresh request.

states.name: SETTLE
states.rule: Only after qualified closure; account switch and ADC charge, source recovery and settle interval.

states.name: ACQUIRE
states.rule: Only while all qualifications and settled/valid reference remain true; timestamp actual measurement boundary.

states.name: TRIP
states.rule: Invalidate immediately on any fault/unknown; bounded physical isolation, analog exposure and discharge must be proven.

states.name: REARM
states.rule: No automatic sample-valid recovery; fresh qualification/request and complete settling are required.
